class_imbalance: class_weight='balanced' weights training classes inversely to their frequency. Scores are not calibrated probabilities at the natural class prevalence.

preprocessing.missing_values: SimpleImputer(strategy='median', add_indicator=True), fitted on training-fold rows only (models with IMPUTE_MISSING = False pass NaNs to an estimator with native support)
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler fitted on training-fold rows (only models that request scaling)

label_policy: Fit on trusted labelled C2 rows only (label not null; ambiguous/unaligned observations excluded). Scores produced for all candidate rows.
metric_definitions: src/evaluation/metrics.py (candidate metrics at threshold 0.5; precision/recall *_pos = positive class, f1_macro = unweighted mean over both classes; Top-1 over trusted observations)
limitations: Defaults were selected by the original training-only three-fold search; the integrated run evaluates them on the canonical five folds.
Class-weighted scores are uncalibrated; evaluate log loss before HMM integration.
No Bayesian optimisation or HMM route reconstruction is included.
Labels come from M1's derived reference alignment, not verified ground truth.
Candidate/observation metrics only; no HMM or route-level result.
